info.title: casmi26-glacier
info.description: GLACIER (ms-pred, MassSpecGym checkpoint, MIT) as an offline isomer re-scorer for the CASMI26 notebook: subprocess runner gl_runner.py (fork of casmi26-iceberg ice_runner.py), notebook glue gl_fuse.py (run_gl, rerank_multi), ms_pred inference subset (MIT), pure-torch DGL / torch_scatter / LinSATNet stand-ins, stripped checkpoint. Reuses the casmi26-iceberg wheels. See README.md and LICENSE-NOTICE.txt.
